audit_trigger: The v1 proof implicitly counted D_A, D_B and D_plus as surviving clauses of the canonical B2 macro. apply_or_pair_v2 canonicalizes/subsumes its output, so a replaced pair clause (a OR b) can become unit (-e), which may subsume D_A=(-e OR -a) and D_B=(-e OR -b). Therefore the unconditional numerical decrements -7 and -10 were too strong.

definitions.pair: nondegenerate sign-aware cooccurring pair (a,b), A=|a|, B=|b|, A!=B
definitions.P_ab: clauses containing both selected literals a and b
definitions.aligned_one_sided_external_incidence: For each clause outside P_ab, A may occur only as a (never -a), and B may occur only as b (never -b).

corrected_theorem.name: CANONICAL_MACRO_FIT_PLUS_ALIGNED_ONE_SIDED_INCIDENCE_GUARANTEES_TWO_CAPPED_ELIMINATIONS
corrected_theorem.statement: If F is root-free, (a,b) satisfies aligned one-sided external incidence, and the canonical B2 macro M fits the frozen cap, then eliminate_var_capped(M,A,cap) succeeds and its canonical output M_A satisfies the same cap; eliminate_var_capped(M_A,B,cap) also succeeds. The final live-variable count is at most the pre-macro count minus one, hence root-free Phi strictly decreases.
proof: Canonicalization can only delete or shorten clauses through tautology removal, deduplication and subsumption; it does not create an opposite-sign external A or B occurrence that was absent structurally.
In M, every A-clause other than an optional D_A=(-e OR -a) has selected polarity a. If D_A is absent, A has no negative bucket and elimination is pure deletion, so raw_A<=s_M.

If D_A is present, every positive external A-clause (a OR R) resolves only against D_A, yielding (-e OR R), whose clause-unit cost is no greater than the parent because e is fresh and canonicalization may only shorten/drop it. Optional D_plus=(e OR a OR b) resolves with D_A tautologically. Hence the raw accumulator never exceeds s_M.

An external A-clause cannot contain variable B: selected b together with selected a would place it in P_ab, while -b is forbidden by the aligned condition. Thus A-resolvents introduce no B occurrence.

After A elimination, every B-clause other than optional D_B=(-e OR -b) has selected polarity b. If D_B is absent, B elimination is pure deletion. If D_B is present, every (b OR S) resolves only with D_B to (-e OR S), with no greater clause-unit cost. Hence raw_B<=state_units(M_A)<=s_M.
Therefore cap admission of M alone guarantees both raw-capped exact eliminations under the aligned condition; no post-macro Cartesian external-bucket explosion exists in this corridor.
A and B are distinct old live variables and at most fresh e is added, so final live-variable count is <=v_before-1. In the root-free phase Phi=v, giving strict progress.
Frozen v3 enumerates all cooccurring pair candidates and ordered pairs of distinct pre-macro live pivots, so the certified plan is discoverable by the existing deterministic search.

conditional_sharpening.condition: If D_A, D_B and D_plus all survive in canonical M and the relevant same-polarity external clauses survive as charged parents, then the stronger bookkeeping reductions from v1 apply: raw_A<=s_M-7 and raw_B<=s_M-10. These are optional sharpenings, not prerequisites for cap safety.

remaining_gap.name: MIXED_SIGN_EXTERNAL_BUCKET_PRODUCT
remaining_gap.necessary_for_escaping_this_corridor: For every cap-admissible candidate pair in a genuine v3 availability gap, at least one selected variable must have opposite-sign external incidence after structural/canonical effects, or another gate such as extension budget must block the plan.
remaining_gap.next_target: Quantify mixed-sign external positive/negative bucket product using counts and tail-literal masses, with raw pre-subsumption charging and second-pivot propagation explicitly included.
